purpose: 4PL engine selection on one fixture (numerical validation only; no Monte Carlo, no certification).
model: P = c + (d - c) / (1 + exp(-a(theta - b))), D = 1, theta ~ N(0,1) fixed, marginal ML, no priors; bounds a [.1,5], b [-6,6], c [0,.5], d [.5,1] (R: a1/g/u boxed, intercept free; b = -d_R/a)

candidates.python_mirt: reuse validation/four_pl_gh_refinement/result.json (PR #145; GH101 Newton-polished MLE); no refit
candidates.R_mirt_1.48: NEW execution in CI: itemtype '4PL', method EM, TOL 1e-8, NCYCLES 20000, SE FALSE, default deterministic starts, customTheta/customPriorFun = the same GH grid; bounded sequence: GH61 then GH101 (two fits)
candidates.R_TAM / R_ltm: eligible only if the installed API exposes an estimated upper asymptote (checked by formals in CI); otherwise UNSUPPORTED

common_evaluator: validation/r_mirt_phase1/equivalence_audit.evaluate (logLik), m12_diagnostic.scores + feasible_scores (projected raw score), information_audit.information (active-face information)

gates_per_engine.stationary_objective: projected raw score <= 1e-5 on the engine's own objective grid
gates_per_engine.audit_GH161: projected raw score <= 1e-5 on GH161 at the same parameters and |logLik_GH161 - logLik_objective| <= 1e-3

agreement_reported: common logLik difference, max |param| difference after mapping, max |ICC| and |IIF| difference on theta in [-4,4] (161 points)
decision: A: R mirt passes all gates -> numerically validated on this fixture, candidate primary. B: an alternative R engine passes and R mirt fails. C: Python passes and outperforms. D: no candidate passes -> NO VALIDATED 4PL ENGINE; production default unchanged. Fixture validation is never population-level recovery/SE/CI validation or certification.
